documents.title: Syllabus and Policies for Generative AI (student considerations + Provost Recommended Language, three tiers)
tiers: Circumstantially permitted with explicit permission only
documents.summary: ASU's Provost-recommended guide tells instructors to state their generative AI expectations in the syllabus and offers student considerations on verification, disclosure and privacy. It supplies three sample syllabus statements, from general permission to a full ban, each tied to the ASU Academic Integrity Policy.
documents.stance_why: The page offers 'Sample syllabi statements for three distinct approaches' (generally permitted, circumstantially permitted with explicit permission only, no use permitted) and says 'each course has unique goals and values', so it sets no single stance and hands the choice to instructors; it is a tiered template, hence delegates.

documents.summary: The Provost page presents ASU's approach to AI as Principled Innovation and promotes the CreateAI Builder and ChatGPT EDU platforms for faculty, staff and student-facing GPTs. It contains little rule text beyond platform notes, an ongoing-resource promise and a definition of generative AI.

documents.summary: The College of Liberal Arts and Sciences tells units and faculty to decide whether student generative AI use is permitted or prohibited and to state it in syllabi.
